summary.title: From Shadow Demons to Shattered Worlds: The Fall of the Terror and the Descent into the Joker World
summary.synopsis: The session covers two one-shots. First, Noah's Cagley Middle one-shot concludes as the four 8th-grade heroes descend into the Terror of Cagley's lair and slay the shadow demon through a prolonged battle where the party's stacked fear defenses neutralize its signature mechanics. Then Josh's new Scale one-shot opens with four high-ranking Scale operatives dispatched to a Joker World far out on the Infinite Horizon to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure. They traverse a rain-soaked shattered landscape, descend into a chasm where their divine connection weakens, and begin climbing out only to be swarmed by hordes of demon spawn.
key_beats: The 8th graders enter the Terror of Cagley's lair at the bottom of Mt. Cagley and spot the shadow demon 100 feet away in the darkness.
Pete spends three preparatory actions charging a Kamehameha (Inner Radiance Torrent); the Terror hits Pete with Visions of Death, frightening him and dealing mental damage.

Combat unfolds with the Terror spamming fear effects (Visions of Death, Teeth to Terror, Ghoulish Cravings, Fear) that are largely negated by the party's fear defenses (Fighter Bravery, Courageous Anthem, Counter Performance, immunity to frightened).
Billy casts Befuddle (clumsy + stupefied) and a lingering Courageous Anthem lasting four rounds; Pete drops a Protectorate Tree on the battlefield.
Ren trips the Terror with a nat 20 crit, knocking it prone; Chuck's reactive strikes keep punishing it when it tries to stand.
Ren delivers the killing blow — stabbing the demon with his spear and channeling light energy to explode it. The cavern collapses and the party escapes into daylight.
Ren grabs Fandra Fiddlesticks' blouse as evidence on the way out. The town of Cagley is safe, but the party is in trouble with their parents. (End of Noah's one-shot.)

Josh's Scale one-shot begins: four high-ranking Scale members (Sir Cliff, Gregor, the Reverend, and Zangren Lee) are transported toward a Joker World 221,325 steps starward to investigate a slip-shielded structure that spooked a previous scout party.

The team arrives on the shattered Joker World — indigo rain, broken plateaus, deep chasms. Occultism reveals the rain splotches resemble blood splatter. They descend into a dry chasm and notice their raiment (divine connection) dims to half strength as they go deeper.

Descending further, they find spongy ground, hot jagged lines on the walls that evaporate rain, and a mental probe asking 'Is this worth it?' and 'How far am I willing to go?' — three of four fail their saves but answer with devotion.

Climbing out of the chasm, cracks open in the walls and small red-yellow scaly demon spawn (Hellion Swarms) begin pouring out. Initiative is rolled and combat begins against hordes of these creatures.

The party cleaves through swaths of demons using holy damage (from Cliff's Aura of Faith), swipe attacks, reactive strikes, and Gregor's Share Rage. Gregor takes heavy damage from the swarm's claws, fangs, and horns. The fight is paused mid-combat at session's end.
characters_present: Sir Cliff Vandertrip of the Everchain
Reverend Warden Manuel de la Cruzada
locations: The Terror's lair beneath Mt. Cagley
The dry chasm beneath the plateau
The slip-shielded structure (distant, not yet reached)
summary.cliffhanger: The Scale delving team is mid-combat against the remaining Hellion Swarms atop the crevasse, with Gregor badly wounded. The mysterious slip-shielded structure still awaits them in the distance.
